info.title: Closet API
info.description: Closet's JSON API for native clients. Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/token and send the device token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A 401 on any route means sign in again. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json; switch on `code`.

put.summary: Uploads a garment's photo, replacing the one it has
put.description: multipart/form-data with one `photo` part, read as the photo sheet reads it (a second file is a 413; an image it cannot read, or one past 64 megapixels, a 400). Your own wardrobe or a MANAGE share, checked before the upload is read. The background removal follows: poll GET /garments/{id} until `photo.cutoutStatus` is no longer `pending`. Each call stores a new photo, which replaces the last.

post.summary: Adds a garment from a product link
post.description: Fetches the page (or an image link) and saves the garment as the link import prefills it: name, brand, colours, category, type, materials, price and the first readable photo (its background removal follows). Your own wardrobe or a MANAGE share. Rate limited with the page's link import: 10 a minute between them, then a 429 with Retry-After. A refused fetch is a 400 or 422 whose detail leads with its reason (`blocked-by-site`: the shop refuses automated fetches, so try another retailer, never again); a form the prefill and the fields given cannot save (no category) is a 400 naming the field.
